# 12-Week Postpartum Return Programme — Master Summary

**Client:** 33 y/o female, 4 weeks post uncomplicated C-section, OB-cleared for light activity only until 6-week check. Home, yoga mat, dumbbells acquired around weeks 5–7. Breastfeeding. Goals: safe return to fitness, restore core function, feel strong by week 12.

---

## Programme at a Glance

| Phase | Programme Weeks | Postpartum Weeks | Focus | Intensity Ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1–2 | 4–6 | Restorative breath + walking | Z1 |
| 2 | 3–4 | 6–8 | Foundational bodyweight strength | Z1–low Z2 |
| 3 | 5–6 | 8–10 | Strength build, light load introduced | Z2–low Z3 |
| 4 | 7–9 | 10–13 | Progressive loading + walk-jog | Z3 |
| 5 | 10–12 | 13–16 | Strength expression, light intervals | Z3 (briefly) |

**Headline rule:** No HIIT, no crunches, no impact in the 12 weeks. She'll be genuinely strong by week 12 — that's the win.

---

## Universal Principles Across All 12 Weeks

1. Breath leads movement — exhale on exertion, no breath-holding under load.
2. Watch for doming/coning at every core progression — appears → regress.
3. Any leaking, heaviness, or pelvic pressure → stop, drop intensity, consider PF physio referral.
4. RIR 3–4 throughout — no grinders, no failure, no max effort.
5. Sleep <4 hrs total → regression session, not progression.
6. Diastasis check at end of each phase.
7. Fuel the work — under-eating crashes supply faster than overtraining does.

---

## PHASE 1 — Programme Weeks 1–2 (Postpartum Weeks 4–6)

**Focus:** Reconnection. No load, no flexion, no impact.
**Sessions:** Daily 10–15 min + walking.

### Daily Session — Breath & Reconnection
- Diaphragmatic breathing — 2 min
- Connection breath (exhale + PF lift + TVA draw) — 2 × 8
- Pelvic tilts supine — 2 × 10
- Glute squeezes — 2 × 10, 2-sec hold
- Supported child's pose — 60 sec
- Cat–cow — 2 × 8
- Side-lying thoracic openers — 1 × 6/side

### Walking
- Week 1: 10–15 min, 1–2×/day, flat
- Week 2: 15–25 min, 1–2×/day
- Stop if bleeding returns to red

### Scar
- Light fingertip contact around (not on) the scar. No mobilisation yet.

**End of phase check:** OB clearance at 6-week appointment + initial diastasis screen.

---

## PHASE 2 — Programme Weeks 3–4 (Postpartum Weeks 6–8)

**Focus:** Foundational bodyweight strength + deep core integration.
**Sessions:** 3–4×/week strength, 25–30 min + walking 20–30 min most days.

### Session A — Core & Posterior Chain
- Connection breath — 2 × 10
- Glute bridge — 3 × 10, slow tempo
- Heel slides — 2 × 8/side
- Dead bug, arms only — 2 × 8/side
- Bird-dog — 3 × 6/side
- Clamshells — 2 × 12/side
- Wall sit — 3 × 20 sec
- Side-lying leg lifts — 2 × 10/side

### Session B — Standing Strength & Posture
- Connection breath standing — 2 × 10
- Bodyweight squat to mat — 3 × 10
- Split stance hold — 2 × 20 sec/side
- Wall push-up — 3 × 8–10
- Standing hip hinge BW — 3 × 10
- Standing towel row (isometric) — 3 × 10
- Calf raises — 2 × 15
- Standing thoracic rotations — 2 × 8/side

### Session C — Mobility & Pelvic Floor
- 90/90 hip rocks — 2 × 6/side
- Happy baby — 60 sec
- Supported deep squat hold — 2 × 30 sec
- Quadruped rocking — 2 × 8
- Supine figure-4 — 45 sec/side
- Thread the needle — 2 × 5/side

### Cardio
- Walking 25–30 min, 5–6 days/week, Z1–low Z2
- Optional short low-impact circuit at end of one strength session

### Scar
- Daily mobilisation now permitted: pads of fingers, skin glide above/below/over, small circles, 2–3 min.

**End of phase check:** Diastasis re-screen. Confirm readiness gates before introducing load.

---

## PHASE 3 — Programme Weeks 5–6 (Postpartum Weeks 8–10) — INTENSIFIED

**Focus:** Real strength build. Light load introduced. Tempo and volume are the primary intensity levers.
**Sessions:** 4 strength + 1 conditioning/mobility, ~30–35 min strength sessions.

### Session A — Lower Body (Quad-Dominant)
| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Load |
|---|---|---|---|
| Goblet squat | 4 × 10 | 3-1-1-0 | 8–12 kg, RIR 3 |
| Reverse lunge | 3 × 8/side | 2-0-1-0 | BW or 2 × 4–6 kg |
| Bulgarian split squat | 3 × 8/side | 3-1-1-0 | BW |
| Single-leg glute bridge | 3 × 10/side | 2-2-1-0 | BW, 2-sec hold |
| Side plank (knees → feet) | 3 × 20 sec/side | — | — |
| Dead bug with light DB | 3 × 8/side | 3-0-3-0 | 2–4 kg |

### Session B — Upper Body
| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Load |
|---|---|---|---|
| Push-up (incline → floor) | 4 × 6–10 | 3-1-1-0 | RIR 3 |
| Single-arm row, hinge | 4 × 10/side | 2-1-1-1 | 7–10 kg |
| Tall kneeling press | 3 × 10 | 2-0-1-1 | 2 × 4–6 kg |
| Bent-over reverse fly | 3 × 12 | 2-1-2-0 | 2 × 2–4 kg |
| Bear hold | 3 × 20 sec | — | BW |
| Pallof press (band) | 3 × 10/side | 2-2-1-0 | Moderate |

### Session C — Lower Body (Hinge-Dominant)
| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Tempo | Load |
|---|---|---|---|
| Romanian deadlift | 4 × 10 | 3-1-1-0 | 2 × 5–8 kg |
| Single-leg deadlift | 3 × 8/side | 3-0-1-0 | 1 × 5–8 kg |
| Step-up | 3 × 8/side | 2-0-1-0 | BW or 2 × 4–6 kg |
| Glute bridge with march | 3 × 10/side | 2-0-2-0 | BW or DB on hips |
| Bird-dog with hold | 3 × 8/side | 2-3-2-0 | 3-sec hold |
| Suitcase carry | 3 × 30 m | — | 1 × 8–12 kg |

### Session D — Upper + Core Density
**Week 5: straight sets. Week 6: circuit format.**
3 rounds, 45 sec on / 15 sec off, 90 sec between rounds:
- Push-up → Row (L) → Row (R) → Tall kneeling press → Dead bug → Side plank (alt sides per round)

### Session E — Conditioning + Mobility
- 25–35 min brisk walk with inclines
- 15 min mobility flow

### Cardio (Phase 3)
| Day | Session |
|---|---|
| Mon | Z2 walk 30–40 min |
| Wed | Z2 walk with hills 30–40 min |
| Fri | Z1 recovery walk 20–30 min |
| Sat | 10-min low-impact circuit after Strength C |
| Sun | Long Z2 walk 45–60 min |

**Week 5:** RIR 4. **Week 6:** RIR 3, add 1–2 kg where Week 5 felt easy.

**End of phase check:** Diastasis re-screen. PF symptom check.

---

## PHASE 4 — Programme Weeks 7–9 (Postpartum Weeks 10–13)

**Focus:** Loaded strength endurance, walk-jog intervals if PF cleared, dynamic core prep.
**Sessions:** 4 strength + 2 cardio, 35–45 min strength sessions.

### Pelvic Floor Readiness Test (do at start of Phase 4)
10 heel raises → 10 jumping jacks in place → 1 min jog in place.
Watch for: leaking, heaviness, doming, pain.
**Pass** → proceed with walk-jog intervals.
**Fail** → stay on walking only, refer to pelvic health physio.

### Session A — Lower Body Strength
- Tempo squat (3-sec down): 4 × 10
- Reverse lunge with reach: 3 × 10/side
- Single-leg deadlift: 3 × 8/side, 1 × 5–8 kg
- Glute bridge march: 3 × 12/side
- Side plank from feet (or knees): 3 × 20 sec/side
- Dead bug with load: 3 × 8/side

### Session B — Upper Body Strength
- Push-up (incline → floor): 4 × 6–10
- Single-arm row: 3 × 10/side, 7–10 kg
- Pike push-up: 3 × 6
- Tall kneeling press: 3 × 10, 2 × 4–6 kg
- Bear crawl (slow): 3 × 4 lengths
- Hollow hold (knees bent): 3 × 15 sec

### Session C — Full Body Circuit
3 rounds, 40 sec work / 20 sec rest:
Squat → Push-up → Reverse lunge → Bird-dog → Glute bridge → Dead bug → Side plank

### Session D — Posterior Chain & Carries
- Romanian deadlift: 4 × 8, 2 × 8–10 kg
- Single-leg deadlift: 3 × 8/side, 1 × 8 kg
- Step-up: 3 × 8/side, 2 × 4–6 kg
- Suitcase carry: 3 × 30 m, 1 × 10–12 kg
- Pallof press: 3 × 10/side
- Bear hold: 3 × 20 sec

### Cardio (Phase 4)
| Day | Session |
|---|---|
| Mon | Walk-jog intervals: 5 min walk + 8 × (1 min jog / 2 min walk) + 5 min walk |
| Wed | Z2 walk with hills 40 min |
| Thu | 12-min low-impact conditioning circuit after Session B |
| Fri | Z1 recovery walk 30 min |
| Sun | Long Z2 walk 60 min |

**Focus:** Strength expression. Density circuits. Light intervals. Cautious anterior core test.
**Sessions:** 4–5×/week, 40–45 min.

- Squat (tempo or paused): 4 × 10
- Reverse lunge: 3 × 10/side

- Push-up: 4 × 8 (full or elevated as needed)
- Towel/DB row: 4 × 12

- Tall kneeling press: 4 × 10

- Min 1: 10 squats

- Hip hinge / RDL: 4 × 10
- Bird-dog: 3 × 8/side
- Bear crawl: 3 × 6 lengths
- Dead bug: 3 × 10/side
- Side plank with hip dip: 3 × 8/side

## NUTRITION PLAN (Breastfeeding-Supportive)

### Daily Targets
- **Calories:** 2,400–2,600/day (maintenance + lactation)
- **Protein:** 125–155 g (1.8–2.2 g/kg)
- **Fat:** 55–70 g
- **Carbohydrate:** 280–340 g
- **Fibre:** 25–35 g
- **Fluid:** 3–3.5 L/day, more on cardio days

**Do not drop below ~1,800 kcal/day while breastfeeding.** Fat loss focus only post-supply-establishment, max 0.25–0.5 kg/week.

### Plate Template Every Meal
¼ protein (palm) + ¼ starch (cupped hand) + ½ veg/fruit + thumb of fat + fluid

### Meal Pattern
3 meals + 2–3 snacks. High-protein breakfast anchors the day. Bedside snack + water for night feeds.

### Priority Micronutrients
- Continue prenatal multivitamin
- Vitamin D 1,000–2,000 IU/
